note: Every fan-made sprite file my151 serves from public/sprites/pokemon: Pokémon #650-#1025 (Alcremie as its sweet files), the PokéAPI forms from 10025 up that a tool shows, my151's own form ids, and the Alcremie files. Game Freak's sprites (#1-#649, Generation 5 forms, Unown, seasonal Deerling and Sawsbuck, East Sea Shellos and Gastrodon, Spiky-eared Pichu, Generation 4-5 female sprites, Overdrive forms) are left out. Built 2026-10-13 from production 60662926 by credits-tools/build_attribution.py from exact and near pixel matches (evidence/*.json). Copied into the app on 2026-10-13 with these changes: KyleDove merged into Kyle Dove; DJ Rotom (11112) credited to KingOfThe-X-Roads as his own upload; Mega Eelektross (10290) credited to Ghasty001 with kiriaura's base sprite; MyMarshlands added to Mega Victreebel (10279); Mega Zygarde (10301) marked as my151's; the cleanup notes of the old spriteSources.json kept. Corrected on 2026-10-13 (credits-research/app-data/CHANGES.md): same-colour sheet rows, a sheet cell parsed again, five name merges or renames with proof, five stale files renamed, Mega Victreebel's and DJ Rotom's sources. Trimmed on 2026-10-13: the files that no tool showed were deleted with their rows (869.png, which Alcremie's sweet files replace; the Pumpkaboo and Gourgeist sizes 10027-10032; and 31 PokéAPI forms from 10093 to 10259 that the app gives other ids, uses another file for, or leaves out). On 2026-10-16, two source-only rows were added or updated for the PokéAPI variants of Spiky-eared Pichu and female Pyroar; individual authorship is unproven.
